metadata.description: Definitive test architecture contract for OpsIQ CI/CD pipeline. Documents exact commands, environment variables, and test execution strategy across all gates.
metadata.purpose: Prevents command flapping, fake-green testing, and ensures reproducible test execution across all CI gates

ci_yml_build_and_test.purpose: Comprehensive test suite with full database access and all test types

security.reason: Tests must pass to allow merge; failures block the gate

ci_cd_foundations_test.purpose: Fast, lightweight test gate without database dependency for quick PR feedback
includes: All unit tests except those marked [db]
Core logic tests that don't need persistence
excludes: All tests with [db] in name (requires database)

security.reason: Tests must pass; any failure must be visible and actionable

test.purpose: Default test command - includes all non-DB tests

test:ci.use_case: Default for CI execution when combined with TEST_WITH_DB env var
test:ci.note: When TEST_WITH_DB=true is set in CI workflow, this becomes the full test suite

setup_files: vitest.setup.ts - conditional DB initialization based on TEST_WITH_DB

database_dependent_tests.identification: Tests marked with [db] in name OR in excluded directories
database_dependent_tests.execution: Only run when TEST_WITH_DB=true AND database service is available
database_dependent_tests.examples: sync-engine tests, runtime-proof tests, phase-a through phase-i tests

non_database_tests.identification: All other tests, especially error classification and governance tests
non_database_tests.execution: Run in both TEST_WITH_DB=true and TEST_WITH_DB=false contexts

fake_green_testing_prevention.pattern_to_prevent: Using continue-on-error: true to hide test failures
enforcement: All test steps in ci.yml have continue-on-error: false
All test steps in ci-cd-foundations.yml have no continue-on-error (default: false)
vitest.config.ts uses dynamic exclusion instead of ignore-patterns workaround
No tests are skipped; they are either run or excluded based on TEST_WITH_DB

test_execution_guarantee.ci_cd_foundations: Fast gate runs all non-DB tests without PostgreSQL service
test_execution_guarantee.ci_yml: Full gate runs all tests with PostgreSQL service for complete coverage
test_execution_guarantee.non_production: TEST_WITH_DB=false is never forced; respects environment (defaults to true if not set)
test_execution_guarantee.no_silent_failures: All test failures surface in CI, no continue-on-error hiding

self_reporting_diagnostics.purpose: Make CI workflow failures self-report their root cause
implementation: github.step_summary annotations for test failure details
Error logs captured in job output on test failure
Workflow status table showing which gate failed
files_to_update: .github/workflows/ci.yml - add failure handling to build-and-test job
.github/workflows/ci-cd-foundations.yml - add failure handling to test job

rationale.why_two_gates: ci-cd-foundations provides fast PR feedback (no DB setup), ci.yml provides comprehensive validation (full DB tests). Developers get quick signal from foundations, maintainers verify full suite before merge.
rationale.why_test_with_db_env: Controls which tests run without modifying test files. Allows same codebase to run fast subset or full suite depending on CI environment.
rationale.why_maxworkers_1: Prevents test flakiness from race conditions and resource contention in CI environments with limited resources.
rationale.why_dynamic_exclusion: Tests are conditionally excluded (not skipped/marked), ensuring coverage metrics and test discovery remain accurate.
rationale.why_no_continue_on_error: Failures must be visible. continue-on-error: true is a false-green pattern that hides real problems and delays root cause analysis.

validation_checklist.test_command_consistency: npm test, npm run test:ci, and npm run test:all must match their expanded vitest equivalents
validation_checklist.test_with_db_propagation: TEST_WITH_DB=true in ci.yml job env must be visible to all test steps
validation_checklist.database_availability: ci.yml must have postgres service; ci-cd-foundations must not
validation_checklist.exclusion_logic: vitest.config.ts exclude array and testNamePattern must match TEST_WITH_DB logic
validation_checklist.no_fake_green: No continue-on-error: true on test steps (other steps may use it, but not tests)
validation_checklist.failure_visibility: All test failures must appear in CI logs and workflow summary
validation_checklist.merge_blocker: Test failures must prevent merge (no overrides, no skips, no force-push workarounds)
